Are excellent communicators, both written and verbal.

Previous experience in fintech, embedded finance, or payments infrastructure.
Experience selling into or working with HR technology and vertical SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with risk, regulatory, and compliance considerations in financial services.

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.
Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source.

Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.
With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.
With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

Own the development and execution of a targeted VAR strategy.
Identify, recruit, and activate high-potential security-focused resellers across the territory.
Build and manage regional partner business plans and track key KPIs such as partner-sourced pipeline and revenue contribution.
Partner Enablement & Growth

Develop go-to-market campaigns, joint events, and demand gen programs.
Support field sales in co-selling motions, lead sharing, and opportunity registration.

Conduct regular QBRs, pipeline reviews, and sales alignment sessions.
Support partner success through consistent engagement, feedback loops, and performance incentives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with marketing on regional partner campaigns, event sponsorships, and content localization.
Work with sales ops and finance on territory forecasting, tracking, and partner ROI analysis.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. At Databricks, we help public institutions use data and AI to improve services, increase productivity, and get more value from public data and technology investment. That means putting trusted, relevant insight closer to the people making operational, policy and service decisions, and building services that can evolve as missions, technology and delivery models change, rather than becoming tomorrow's legacy.
Databricks is looking for an Account Executive to own and grow some of our most strategic Public Sector customers in the UK government delivering against their core missions. You will inherit an established portfolio of strategic government accounts, with a clear mandate to protect and expand that base while building new relationships across departments and agencies we do not yet serve.
This is a succession role: you will step into relationships and momentum that already exist, building trust quickly with current stakeholders while developing your own view of where Data and AI can help solve the sector's most important challenges. You will translate national and departmental priorities into measurable customer outcomes and sustainable growth.
Working closely with government stakeholders, internal teams, cloud providers, and strategic partners, you will deepen consumption in existing accounts and extend Databricks' footprint.
The Pressures Shaping This Work
Government's hardest missions increasingly require insight across institutional boundaries, without requiring those institutions, their accountability, or their data to be centralised. The opportunity isn't one giant government data system; it's enabling institutions to connect, govern and use data and insight across boundaries while retaining control of their own data, responsibilities and decisions. You'll be selling into that reality.
The Impact You Will Have
Take ownership of an existing portfolio of strategic government accounts, maintaining continuity with current stakeholders and expanding usage of the Databricks Intelligence Platform.
Build and execute a go-to-market plan for the territory, prioritising the departments, agencies, use cases, and partners most likely to create sustainable growth.
Identify and pursue net-new opportunities across departments and agencies not yet engaged with Databricks, building pipeline alongside your existing portfolio.
Develop a clear view of national and departmental priorities and translate them into compelling Data and AI value propositions, executive conversations, business cases, and qualified opportunities.
Use data and evidence to continuously refine your territory strategy, testing assumptions about where demand exists and which use cases resonate, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.
Map and engage the full range of buying centres within each account, building champions, guiding opportunities forward, and compressing decision cycles.
Run a consumption-led sales motion, using demand plans to prioritise the highest-value use cases in each account and grow usage over time rather than closing one-off deals.
Manage a portfolio that spans quick wins and longer, complex public-sector sales cycles simultaneously.
Build and defend a strong renewal and expansion motion within existing accounts as a foundation for new growth.
Orchestrate cross-functional and partner resources, including professional services, training, systems integrators, and hyperscaler co-sell teams, to maximise account impact.
Represent Databricks credibly with senior government stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor who puts customer outcomes first.
What We Look For
A strong track record of quota attainment or over-achievement selling into public-sector accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build a territory-level go-to-market strategy from first principles, reasoning from the fundamentals of how the sector works rather than importing a playbook from somewhere else.
Experience managing an existing account portfolio through a transition, building trust quickly with inherited relationships while also prospecting for new ones.
Working knowledge of UK Government structures, national and departmental priorities, procurement frameworks, and how public-sector technology decisions are funded, approved, and implemented.
Sales experience in cloud software, data platforms, open-source technology, Data and AI, or a related enterprise technology market.
Experience selling usage-based or consumption-based models and co-selling with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Comfort running both land-and-expand motions in existing accounts and greenfield business development across new departments and agencies.
Experience co-developing business cases and building relationships with senior civil-service stakeholders.
Experience using structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Value Selling, with disciplined and accurate forecasting.
A willingness to challenge assumptions, your own and others', and use evidence to make better decisions rather than relying on intuition alone.
Eligibility for security clearance; existing clearance is an advantage.

**Key Account Manager:in**
**Ihre Rolle**
Als Key Account Manager:in am MAZ bauen Sie unsere aktive Kundenakquise insbesondere für massgeschneiderte Angebote auf und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Sie identifizieren neue Kund:innen und Marktbedürfnisse und bauen langfristige Beziehungen auf. Von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Offerte bis zum Abschluss sorgen Sie dafür, dass aus Kundenbedürfnissen konkrete Aufträge werden.
**Ihre Verantwortung**
* **Marktbearbeitung:** Sie sprechen Unternehmen, Verwaltungen, öffentliche Institutionen, staatsnahe Betriebe, Verbände, Non\-Profit\-Organisationen, Kommunikationsabteilungen und Medienhäuser aktiv an und gewinnen neue Kund:innen.
* **Kund:innenentwicklung:** Sie identifizieren und qualifizieren Leads, führen Erst\- und Bedarfsgespräche und bauen, in enger Abstimmung mit der CEO, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.
* **Angebotsentwicklung:** Sie übersetzen Kundenbedürfnisse gemeinsam mit unserem Chief Product Officer (CPO) und Studienleitungen in passende Weiterbildungsangebote.
* **Offerten \& Abschlüsse:** Sie erstellen und kalkulieren Offerten, fassen systematisch nach und gewinnen neue Aufträge und Wiederholungsaufträge.
* **Sales\-Funnel \& CRM:** Sie bauen einen professionellen Sales\-Funnel auf, pflegen Kund:innendaten und sorgen für klare und verbindliche Nachfassprozesse.
* **Marktfeedback:** Sie bringen Erkenntnisse aus Kund:innengesprächen ins MAZ zurück und liefern damit wichtige Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung und Positionierung unserer Angebote.
* **Kundenbetreuung:** Sie begleiten die Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zur Übergabe an CPO, Studienleitungen und Administration und sorgen für eine konsistente Kundenerfahrung.
**Das bringen Sie mit**
**1\. Verkauf \& Kundenentwicklung**
* **B2B\-Erfahrung:** Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf, Business Development, Key Account Management oder in der beratungsnahen Kund:innenentwicklung, idealerweise in der Medien\- und Kommunikationsbranche.
* **Beratungskompetenz:** Sie erkennen Kundenbedürfnisse, strukturieren diese und entwickeln daraus gemeinsam mit unseren Fachpersonen konkrete Lösungen.
* **Beziehungsmanagement:** Sie wissen, wie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut, gepflegt und weiterentwickelt werden.
* **Abschlussstärke:** Sie haben Freude an aktiver Marktbearbeitung, verfolgen Offerten konsequent und orientieren sich an messbaren Ergebnissen.
**2\. Markt\- \& Angebotsverständnis**
* **Weiterbildung \& Kommunikation:** Sie interessieren sich für Themen wie Journalismus, Kommunikation, KI, Medienkompetenz, Auftrittskompetenz und Weiterbildung.
* **Konzeptionelles Denken:** Sie können Kund:innenbedürfnisse in passgenaue Angebote übersetzen und arbeiten dafür eng mit internen Fachpersonen zusammen.
* **Sales\-Prozesse:** Erfahrung mit CRM, Sales\-Funnel, Pipeline\-Steuerung und systematischer Angebotsnachfassung ist von Vorteil.
* **Kommunikation:** Sie kommunizieren schriftlich und mündlich stilsicher und erstellen überzeugende Offerten, Angebotsunterlagen und Kundenkorrespondenz.
**3\. Persönlichkeit**
* **Kund:innenorientierung:** Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis und treten gegenüber Geschäftsleitungen, HR, Kommunikationsverantwortlichen und öffentlichen Institutionen souverän auf.
* **Unternehmerisches Denken:** Sie erkennen Chancen, gehen aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu und haben Freude daran, neue Märkte zu entwickeln.
* **Verbindlichkeit:** Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und beharrlich und behalten Ihre Pipeline im Blick.
* **Teamorientierung:** Sie arbeiten eng mit der CEO, CPO, Studienleitungen, Marketing, Administration und weiteren Fachpersonen zusammen und verstehen Verkauf als gemeinsame Aufgabe.
**Das bieten wir Ihnen**
* Die Möglichkeit, die Marktbearbeitung des MAZ aktiv mit aufzubauen und zu professionalisieren.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum an der Schnittstelle von Verkauf, Weiterbildung, Journalismus und Kommunikation.
* Ein breites Netzwerk aus Medien, Unternehmen, Verwaltungen und öffentlichen Institutionen.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, Marketing sowie unseren Studienleitungen und ausgewiesenen Fachpersonen.
* Einen Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Luzern sowie regelmässigen direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen in der Deutschschweiz und künftig schweizweit.

Pipeline Generation — Build, maintain, and continuously refine a prioritised list of high-value target prospects within your assigned territory. You own your pipeline. That means cold calling, outbound prospecting, and finding creative ways to get in front of the right people.

Product Mastery & Value-Based Selling — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Run flawless demos tailored to each audience, and clearly articulate business and security outcomes to stakeholders from security engineers to CISOs and Heads of AI.
Drive Revenue — Lead discovery sessions, product demos, proof-of-concept engagements, and customer evaluations from first call to closed-won.
CRM Discipline — Keep Hubspot (or equivalent) meticulously up to date. Clean data, accurate stages, clear next steps. Your pipeline should be something anyone on the team can read and trust.
Customer Success — Own the relationship post-close. Our customers' success is your success. You'll ensure they're getting full value from Geordie and expanding over time.
Forecasting & Deal Management — Maintain a rigorous, accurate pipeline and deliver reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts with clear visibility into deal status, risks, and next steps.
Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to execute deals well and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

This role is not for everyone. We're looking for a specific kind of person — one who competes hard, earns trust fast, and knows how to move complex deals through enterprise buying cycles without losing momentum.
You compete to win — and your track record shows it. You don't just hit quota, you know exactly why you hit it and how to repeat it.
You're a builder. Early-stage means no perfect playbook, no full SDR support, no hand-holding. You create structure where there isn't any and find a way.
You prospect without being asked. Cold calls, creative outbound, referrals — you don't wait for leads to land in your lap.
You get technical. You invest the time to truly understand what you sell, and you can demo the product confidently and compellingly to any audience
You earn trust at every level. You can hold a technical conversation in the morning and present to an executive in the afternoon without losing credibility in either room.
You listen before you talk. Strong discovery is your foundation. You ask sharp questions, identify real pain, and connect it to outcomes — not features.
You keep a clean house. Your CRM is always current, your forecasts are reliable, and your deals have clear next steps. You treat pipeline data as a professional obligation, not an afterthought.
You make the people around you better. You share what's working, coach peers proactively, and invest in the team's success — not just your own number.
You're obsessed with your customers. Not just during the deal. You care whether they succeed, and it shows in how you show up post-close.
You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — including agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You're curious about the tools we build and the tools we use.
You thrive in ambiguity. You don't wait for perfect information — you make a call, move, and course correct.

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Spreedly, you’ll act as a strategic advisor and growth partner to a defined portfolio of high-value customers. You’ll own retention and expansion across complex accounts and build multi-threaded relationships that uncover value and strengthen customer commitment.

This role requires curiosity and commercial discipline, blending relationship development with commercial execution. It requires the ability to manage both transactional details and strategic outcomes.
You will succeed by proactively aligning stakeholders, identifying opportunities for value improvement or acceleration, and guiding customers through Spreedly’s evolving platform.

Your role will contribute to Spreedly’s growth by driving insights at the account level, expanding relationships with stakeholders, and ensuring that customers fully realize the benefits of our payments orchestration platform.

Achieving success requires a thoughtful and consultative approach, along with the ability to support alignment across different functions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, enjoys solving customer challenges, and is energized by a culture of continuous learning and growth.
This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

Lead account planning and deliver quarterly business reviews with clear success metrics
Build strategic multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations

Additional Information

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

## Wie Sie uns kontaktieren können ##
Wir freuen uns auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint.

Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

We're reimagining enterprise Identity and Access Management from the ground up. Founded by serial entrepreneurs Shai Morag and Tal Marom and backed by a $60M seed round from Greylock, Accel, and CRV, we're building the next generation of identity security.

Identity is the gateway to everything- who's let in, who's kept out, and it's now the number one attack vector in the enterprise. The tools built to govern it were designed for a slower world of human users and static environments. That world is gone.

Identities are exploding across human, machine, and AI agents faster than legacy systems can track, and security teams are left patching together five disconnected tools that still can't answer "who has access to what, right now." We think the answer isn't another point solution- it's a new foundation.

Oak is the AI-native Identity Operating System: an AI connector framework that reaches any application, a live identity graph built from raw evidence, and a team of AI agents that governs the full lifecycle of every identity in one platform.

We're building Oak's AI-native core from day one-engineered for what enterprise identity is becoming, not patched onto what it used to be. And we're just getting started.

· Own the full sales cycle end-to-end — from cold prospecting and structured discovery through high-stakes demos, commercial negotiations, and close — with no handoffs as an excuse to disengage.

· Identify, prioritize, and penetrate Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, navigating complex organizational structures to reach and influence the security, IAM, and IT stakeholders who control identity programs.

· Apply MEDDIC rigorously across every active opportunity to drive forecast accuracy, expose risk early, and maintain consistently high win rates in competitive deals.

· Maintain precise, up-to-date pipeline data in HubSpot — your hygiene standards will be the foundation as Oak scales from founder-led sales into a repeatable, process-driven revenue motion.

· Partner directly with Oak's Tel Aviv product team to surface pattern-matched feedback from the field — translating what CISOs, IAM leads, and architects are telling you about identity attack surface, NHI risks, and access governance gaps into input that shapes the roadmap.

· Act as a credible domain presence in conversations about IGA, identity lifecycle, and AI agent proliferation — buyers need to trust that you understand their environment before they'll open the door to Oak's IVIP.

· 5–10 years of closing experience as an Enterprise Account Executive in high-growth SaaS, with a background in cybersecurity — you understand the pace, the pressure, and what it takes to operate in a hyper-growth environment.

· Demonstrated track record of exceeding $1M+ annual quotas; you don't just hit your number, you own it.

· Experience at an early-stage startup (Seed or Series A) — you know how to build pipeline and win deals without a mature playbook behind you.
· Fluent in structured discovery and disciplined sales cycle management; you run a tight process and can articulate why at every stage.

· Credible and compelling in the room with CISOs, VP-level security leaders, and executive sponsors — you speak their language and earn their trust quickly.

· East Coast-based and ready to travel to customers; you close enterprise deals in person and know that presence matters at the finish line.

· High-energy, self-directed, and coachable — you bring urgency and accountability to your pipeline, and you operate with the transparency and collaboration that makes the whole team stronger.

As a Corporate Account Executive, you will own new-logo ARR growth across private-sector organisations with 2,000–7,499 employees in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. This is a pure acquisition and self-sourcing role with no inherited customer base or ongoing account-management responsibility.

While you will have access to BDR, Solution Engineering, Partner Account Management and Marketing support, you remain personally accountable for building sufficient pipeline, creating your own qualified opportunities and achieving the ARR target. Once fully ramped, the role will carry an annual net-new ARR quota in the region of US $900,000.
What will you be doing?
You will build, own and execute a territory and pipeline-generation plan that creates sustainable pipeline and converts opportunities into net-new ARR. The territory is not verticalized, so you will use available account intelligence, SKU performance, industry growth and market data to determine where to focus.

You will personally self-source qualified opportunities while using internal and partner resources to extend your reach and accelerate results. You will manage the full sales cycle, from account prioritisation and prospecting through discovery, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close.

Building, owning and executing a data-led territory and pipeline-generation plan that explains how you will achieve your net-new ARR quota, where you will focus, how you will personally create qualified opportunities and which resources you will engage.
Generating business exclusively through new-logo acquisition across the defined private-sector segment; the role will not inherit existing customers.
Using account, industry, SKU-growth and market data to prioritise opportunities and continually refine your territory strategy.
Personally self-sourcing qualified opportunities through disciplined prospecting and account development, while effectively using BDR, Marketing and partner resources to complement—not replace—your own pipeline creation. Building pipeline through a balanced combination of self-sourced activity, BDR support, marketing programmes and partner-led engagement.
Working closely with the Partner Account Manager to identify the right partners, develop joint account plans, create pipeline and progress opportunities. As a channel-first organisation, effective partner engagement is fundamental to success in this role.
Leading consultative, value-based sales cycles across business, technical and executive stakeholders, positioning a platform outcome rather than relying on a single-product sale.
Partnering with Solution Engineering to shape discovery, demonstrate relevant capabilities and build credible business and technical solutions.
Planning and delivering compelling presentations, proposals and business cases that connect customer challenges to measurable outcomes, value and return on investment.
Maintaining strong deal control throughout complex sales cycles, including stakeholder mapping, qualification, mutual action planning, commercial negotiation and accurate forecasting.
Maintaining complete, accurate and current account, opportunity, pipeline and forecast information in the CRM system.
Attending customer and partner meetings remotely and in person across the territory; this is a field-based role in which face-to-face collaboration is expected.
Coordinating with Customer Success when a new customer reaches the applicable ARR threshold, ensuring an effective transition and appropriate post-sale engagement.

You will retain clear ownership of the territory plan, pipeline creation and ARR result while working as part of a collaborative go-to-market team. The supporting teams provide expertise, reach and leverage, but do not replace the Account Executive’s responsibility to self-source opportunities and create sufficient pipeline. Support available includes:
Business Development Representative: support with targeted prospecting, account engagement and meeting creation.
Solution Engineer: technical discovery, demonstrations, solution design and technical validation.
Partner Account Manager: partner strategy, account alignment, introductions, joint pipeline creation and channel-led deal execution.
Marketing: campaigns, events, content, intent signals and account-based support.
Customer Success: post-sale engagement for customers that meet the applicable ARR threshold.
